patient._comment: 'patient' contains player-visible patient data and explanatory triage reasoning for Coach and review.

clinical.quoteLong: The waiter SWORE there was no shrimp in the pad thai. My face is filing a formal dispute. Also I can hear myself wheezing now, which is a sound I've decided I hate.
clinical.presentationShort: 27yo F — facial/lip swelling + wheeze minutes after shellfish.
clinical.presentationLong: 27-year-old female, facial and lip swelling with wheeze minutes after eating shellfish.

triageReasoning.summary: This patient has an immediate airway and circulatory threat requiring lifesaving treatment now.
triageReasoning.acuityReason: Rapid facial and lip swelling with wheezing after shellfish exposure, together with hypotension and low oxygen saturation, indicates a life-threatening allergic reaction.
triageReasoning.destinationReason: ESI 1 / Resus is required because treatment cannot safely wait and immediate lifesaving intervention is necessary.
keyFindings: Facial and lip swelling minutes after shellfish exposure
Heart rate of 128 and respiratory rate of 26
redFlags: Rapid onset after a likely allergen exposure
teachingPoints: ESI 1 is assigned when an immediate lifesaving intervention is required.
Airway swelling and hypotension after allergen exposure require immediate epinephrine and resuscitative care.

possibleDiagnoses: Severe allergic reaction with airway involvement
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would receive immediate epinephrine, airway and oxygen support, IV fluids, close monitoring, and observation for recurrent symptoms after stabilization.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 27-year-old woman in a nice dinner outfit
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting forward on a clinic chair, hand at her throat
signs: raised red hives on her neck and arms
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an Asian 27-year-old woman in a nice dinner outfit, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting forward, one hand at her throat. Expression: wide-eyed alarm, struggling to breathe. Clearly visible: swollen lips and puffy face, raised red hives on her neck and arms. Overall acutely distressed with a threatened airway. No text, no logos.
